clauses.title: CL-D123 records the retirement of the Issue candidate route
requires: The Issue root is review-and-draft only: `/tidd-issue` and `/skill:closed-loop-issue` never edit the Issue or post to GitHub.
CL-D31 and CL-D32 become historical records whose clauses pin only their own files.
`candidateIdentity` stays optional in gate-result schema v2 (CL-D120) and in the gate roles' output schemas, and the Issue root never sets it.

clauses.title: The Issue Skill is review-and-draft only
requires: `/tidd-issue` is review-and-draft only: it never edits the Issue or posts to GitHub (CL-D123).
When a round stops, the owner revises the Issue, and a fresh run reviews the revised text.
The Issue correlation and finding record have no candidate field (CL-D124).
Its `publication_grant` field is always `not-applicable`: the Issue root grants no publication (CL-D123).
